Annual history

Gaps stay gaps. Academic-year labels use their ending year on the axis; the 2020 baseline is 2019/20, not calendar 2020. Reporting-year UIS data are not physical-presence counts.

Source: IIE Open Doors · Open Doors 2025. Reviewed 2025 PDFs are rechecked daily; new annual report discovery requires manual review. The country-factsheet index was access-restricted during source audit.

Academic year ending shown. Pandemic remote participation affects physical-presence interpretation.

What the numbers mean

Students are not departures. Enrolled-only counts, enrollment including OPT, degree mobility, and credit study abroad are separate populations. None is a border-crossing count.

Trips are not unique tourists. NTTO covers overnight visits and all purposes. Destination arrival series can include same-day visits. Leisure-only data are shown only when explicitly reported.

Trade follows exports. U.S. imports are partner → U.S. BEA uses balance-of-payments accounting. Macau goods use Comtrade customs data: exports FOB, imports CIF. Services exclude affiliate sales.

2020 is an unusual baseline. Pandemic restrictions can make percentage rebounds very large. Full annual history and prior-year changes provide context; no causal effect is claimed.
